description: Measured run-off and barriers of brandshatch (tools/real_tracks_data/measure_runoff.py; derived data). Per route and side, zones along the sample's centreline (fromS/toS in the sample's metres; e/e2 the zone ends on the centreline in the recipe's grid): surface gravel|tarmac|grass beyond the road edge, tarmacM (paved apron from the edge), startM/depthM (the gravel trap, metres from the edge), barrier armco|tyres|concrete|bank|none at offsetM from the edge, fence (a debris fence above it), colour (black unless a source confirms red/white), confidence 0-1 and source (lidar, osm, evidence).
sources: Environment Agency National LIDAR Programme point cloud (intensity, classification, heights); Open Government Licence v3.0; Contains Environment Agency information (c) Environment Agency and/or database right
Gravel/paved areas and barrier types: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0
Barrier types the LIDAR can't tell and corner facts: tools/real_tracks_data/runoff_evidence.json (published track guides and circuit news, each with its URL)
evidence: oversteer48.com/brands-hatch-track-day/ (GP loop: minimal run-off, Armco and tyre walls close to the track); brandshatch.co.uk winter works 2022 (Paddock Hill barriers and tyre walls renewed)
method: profiles every 4 m to 60 m beyond the measured road edge, 0.5 m bins; zones mode-filtered over 7 sections, at least 16 m
